sourceManifest.notes: Türkiye-first city points from Natural Earth 10m populated places (public domain). Coordinates copied from source geometry. Not OSM. Not Google. Not AI. Not a production MapData release. OSM remains planned for transport networks (ODbL checkpoint). HGM is QA/reference only and is not bundled.
